components.title: State Store public boundary
components.rationale: src/index.ts exposes runtime state-store lifecycle, archive, retention, restore and delivery-buffer APIs.

components.title: Run state command boundary
components.rationale: Defines the bootstrap/command port and the in-memory implementation used to append authoritative run state transitions.

components.title: Archive unit identity + retention math
components.rationale: Owns deterministic archive unit keys, tenant buckets, delete-after calculation and archive lifecycle state.

components.title: Archive manifests + terminal snapshots
components.rationale: Builds immutable archive manifests, event checksums and pinned/archived terminal snapshots.

components.title: Archive runtime ports + policies
components.rationale: Defines archive stores, leases, restore/delete boundaries, retention policies and lifecycle telemetry.

components.title: Archive lifecycle pipeline
components.rationale: Coordinates export, verification, deletion and restore of run archive units through explicit lifecycle services.

components.title: Archive object-store adapters
components.rationale: Concrete filesystem and S3 implementations of the archive object-store boundary.

components.title: Delivery-buffer retention + purge
components.rationale: Owns delivery-buffer retention policy, purge boundary, telemetry and purge execution.
